title: Confirmed 2026/27 EPR for packaging fees now available - GOV.UK

triage.reason: PackUK published confirmed 2026/27 EPR for packaging waste disposal fees on 25 November 2026, including the first year of modulated Green/Amber/Red fees based on recyclability.

draft.summary: PackUK published confirmed Extended Producer Responsibility for packaging waste disposal fees for 2026/27 on 25 November 2026. For 2026/27, producers pay modulated fees rated Green, Amber or Red according to the recyclability of the packaging they place on the market, in line with the Recyclability Assessment Methodology (RAM).
draft.source_quote: PackUK has today, 25 November 2026, published confirmed Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) for packaging waste disposal fees for 2026/27. For the first time, producers will pay modulated (Green, Amber, or Red) fees, based on the recyclability of the packaging they place on the market, in line with the Recyclability Assessment Methodology (RAM).

key_dates.text: PackUK published confirmed EPR for packaging waste disposal fees for 2026/27.

draft.interpretation: The confirmed modulated fee rates give converters and brand owners a concrete price signal for 2026/27, so packaging rated Green under RAM should carry a lower fee cost than Red-rated formats. Recyclers may see this as a nudge on demand towards widely recyclable materials, though the actual fee levels are not set out in this notice.
